sidebar.title: Your navigation
sidebar.description: Every part of the intranet, grouped by what it's for. Pin favorites to the top, collapse groups you rarely use, or rearrange it with Customize at the bottom.

header.title: Always up here
header.description: Search, notifications, your account and preferences stay in this bar on every page. Page-specific actions appear on its left.

search.title: Search everything
search.description: Find people, pages, announcements, wiki entries and more from anywhere — click here or press ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows).

actions.title: Quick actions
actions.description: Jump straight into the things you do most — upload a file, or (as a manager) create events and announcements.

main.title: Your dashboard
main.description: A snapshot of what's happening — upcoming events, latest news, and who's out today. Every row links to the tab it came from.

customize.title: Make it yours
customize.description: Hide the cards you don't need — your layout is saved to your account and follows you across devices.

nav.title: Company announcements
nav.description: Stay up to date with news and updates from across the organisation.

toolbar.title: Find what matters
toolbar.description: Search the feed, filter to unread or pinned posts, sort by reactions, or clear everything with mark-all-read. Posts count as read once you've actually scrolled past them.

list.title: The announcements feed
list.description: Pinned posts stay on top; long posts collapse behind "read more". React with emoji, open images full-size, and download attachments.

new.title: Publish announcements
new.description: Write rich-text posts for everyone or one department — you'll see how many people it will reach. Pin important ones, schedule for later, set an expiry, and edit after publishing. A draft is kept if you close the dialog.

nav.title: Team calendar
nav.description: View and create events visible to everyone or specific teams.

toolbar.title: Navigate the calendar
toolbar.description: Switch between month, week and agenda views, page through periods with the arrows (or your keyboard's ← → keys, T for today), jump straight to a date, and export the current view as an .ics file.

filters.title: Focus the view
filters.description: The legend is interactive: click a type to hide or show it, narrow to one department, or keep only your own absences. Department-targeted events get their own color.

view.title: Events and absences together
view.description: Events and approved absences (including those synced from Clockodo) share one calendar. Multi-day entries span every day they cover; click a day for its overview or any chip for details.

add.title: Create events
add.description: As a manager you can create events for everyone or a single department. From an event's details you can edit or duplicate it, and clicking a day offers a quick-create shortcut.

nav.title: Absences
nav.description: Request and track vacation, sick days, and personal time.

stats.title: Request time off
stats.description: Log a new vacation, sick day, or personal absence here, or export your approved time off as a calendar file.

filters.title: Find a request
filters.description: Search your requests by type or reason.

list.title: Your requests
list.description: Every absence you've requested, with its live status — pending, approved, or denied. Managers reviewing team requests use the Approvals tab instead.

nav.title: Team messaging
nav.description: Direct messages and group conversations with your colleagues.

list.title: Your conversations
list.description: Start a new chat or pick up where you left off.

nav.title: People directory
nav.description: Find colleagues, see their role, department, and start a chat.

filters.title: Find anyone fast
filters.description: Search matches names, emails, job titles and teams. Combine the department select with role and team chips, change the sorting, group by department, or jump by letter.

grid.title: Browse your team
grid.description: A green dot means someone is online right now; a plane marks colleagues who are currently out. Click a card for the full profile — contact links, manager and direct reports, and upcoming absences.

nav.title: Guidebooks
nav.description: SOPs, case search, and team knowledge — all in one place.

list.title: Your knowledge base
list.description: Search across guidebooks, pin your favorites so they sort first, and jump back in via the "continue where you left off" banner. Inside a guide you get a table of contents, a reading-progress bar, print support, and a quick way to say whether it helped.

nav.title: Help & requests
nav.description: Not sure where something belongs? Start here — it points you to the right place for any problem or question.

report.title: Report or request something
report.description: An IT fault, a quality error, an idea, or time off — each line says when it's the right choice and opens the form straight away.

find.title: Find an answer
find.description: How-tos in the wiki, who to ask for what, and the status page for known issues.

requests.title: Everything you've asked for
requests.description: My requests collects your tickets, error reports, ideas and absences in one list, with where each one stands.

bell.title: Notification bell
bell.description: The bell turns active when something needs your attention.

feed.title: Your notification feed
feed.description: Everything grouped by day. Hover a row to mark it read/unread or dismiss it; older read items tuck away behind a toggle.

prefs.title: Tune what reaches you
prefs.description: Mute individual notification types and opt into native browser notifications for background tabs — the same controls also live in Settings.

nav.title: Your settings
nav.description: Your profile, appearance, notifications, AI and account security all live here.

profile.title: You, at a glance
profile.description: Your name, role and contact details as colleagues see them. Edit profile opens a page with a live preview; passkeys and two-step verification sit right below.

prefs.title: Make the app yours
prefs.description: Pick your default calendar view, the page you land on after signing in, and which day your week starts — saved to your account.

connections.title: Your integrations
connections.description: See whether your Clockodo account is linked (so your absences sync into the intranet).

help.title: Come back anytime
help.description: Run setup again, or replay any part of this tour, from Help and onboarding.

nav.title: Admin panel
nav.description: Manage your team: invite members, approve access requests, and adjust roles.

members.title: Member management
members.description: The Members tab lets you change roles, manage teams, suspend, or remove users.

nav.title: Files
nav.description: Browse the team's OneDrive right here in the intranet.

toolbar.title: Your OneDrive toolbar
toolbar.description: Search the whole drive, switch between list and grid view, create folders, and jump back via the breadcrumbs. Pinned folders and your recent uploads sit right below for quick access.

dropzone.title: Upload files
dropzone.description: Click here or drop files anywhere on the page. Uploads run through a queue in the corner with per-file progress and a retry for anything that fails.

browser.title: Work with files
browser.description: Sort by name, date or size via the column headers, select multiple files for bulk download or delete, and use ↑ ↓ + Enter to navigate by keyboard. The ⋯ menu offers preview, versions, copy-link and folder pinning.
